svg.title: Open source contributions
svg.desc: HADES CLI #32 (Rust, merged): Restored native text selection by removing global mouse capture from the TUI; HADES CLI #30 (Rust, merged): Conversation import and export across HADES, ChatGPT, Claude and Markdown; awesome-ai-apps #317 (Python, merged): Closed a credentialed wildcard CORS hole with an allow-list that fails closed; Node.js #66376 (C++, open): Backport of two V8 fixes for a WebAssembly wrapper lifetime race; LLMVault #44 (Python, open): Brute-force guard for flag submissions: cooldown after five misses, HTTP 429
